vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: deepvista-vistabase-card
Version: 0.1.0-alpha.17

The skill bundle provides a standard interface for managing knowledge cards through the 'deepvista' CLI tool. It includes appropriate safety warnings for write and destructive operations, requiring user confirmation as per the instructions in SKILL.md. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found; the behavior is consistent with the stated purpose of managing a knowledge base via the deepvista.ai service.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for the DeepVista CLI and its requested binaries/install are consistent with the stated purpose of managing DeepVista 'cards'.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name/description match the actions shown in SKILL.md (list/get/create/update/delete/search/pin/archive). It requires the deepvista CLI binary and installs deepvista-cli, which is coherent for a CLI-driven knowledge-card manager. The SKILL.md also declares a dependency on deepvista-shared for auth/config, which is consistent with needing separate auth behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to running the deepvista CLI subcommands and presenting results/URLs. Write operations are explicitly marked to confirm with the user before executing. The only non-trivial runtime action is extracting the JSON response id to construct the app URL — this requires parsing the CLI output but stays within the skill's described purpose. The SKILL.md does not instruct reading unrelated files or environment variables itself.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The install uses a 'uv' package entry for deepvista-cli which creates a deepvista binary. This is a typical CLI install flow, but the install spec lacks a source URL or provenance details in the SKILL.md metadata. Installing a third-party CLI package has moderate risk; verify the package origin (registry, publisher) before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill declares no required env vars or credentials itself. However, it depends on deepvista-shared for auth/profiles/global flags — that sibling skill likely requests credentials or tokens. Review deepvista-shared to see what secrets (API keys, tokens) will be required and ensure they are proportionate to a DeepVista CLI integration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-included and does not request elevated platform privileges. It does install a CLI binary (normal for a CLI skill) but does not declare actions that modify other skills or global agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward wrapper around the official DeepVista CLI. Before installing: (1) inspect the deepvista-shared SKILL.md to see what authentication tokens or env vars it requires — those are the real secrets this skill will use; (2) verify the provenance of the deepvista-cli package (which registry/publisher provides it) before allowing installation; (3) note that write/delete/pin/archive commands will act on your DeepVista account — the skill correctly asks the agent to confirm with you before executing writes, so refuse writes you don't recognize; (4) if you want maximum caution, run the deepvista CLI manually yourself first to see what it does and where it stores credentials (e.g., config files), or inspect the deepvista-cli package source before granting installation.
